outcome: fetal cardiac function parameters (LV Mod-MPI, LV MPI', RV MPI', S', E', A')
cohort: 374 singleton pregnant women were divided into three groups: 154 controls (BMI < 25 kg/m2), 140 overweight (BMI 25-30 kg/m2), and 80 obese (BMI >= 30 kg/m2).
finding: Fetal myocardial dysfunction, characterized by higher LV Mod-MPI, LV MPI', and RV E', was observed in fetuses of overweight and obese pregnant women compared to those of normal weight.
